name: Amino Acid Biosynthesis Pathways
description: E. coli synthesizes all 20 amino acids from central metabolic intermediates. Major biosynthetic families include: glutamate family (Glu, Gln, Pro, Arg) from α-ketoglutarate; aspartate family (Asp, Asn, Met, Thr, Ile, Lys) from oxaloacetate; serine family (Ser, Gly, Cys) from 3-phosphoglycerate; aromatic family (Phe, Tyr, Trp) from PEP + E4P via shikimate; pyruvate family (Ala, Val, Leu) from pyruvate; and histidine from PRPP. Each pathway has 2-12 enzymatic steps with feedback inhibition by end products.
scientificAccuracy: Based on comprehensive biochemical characterization of E. coli amino acid biosynthesis. All pathways validated.
